headline.title: Advancing responsible AI across Europe
headline.summary: OpenAI outlines its commitment to responsible AI governance in Europe, emphasizing safety, security, transparency, and provenance practices. This initiative will progress alongside the development of the EU AI Act.

articles.title: Univé builds an AI-ready workforce
articles.summary: Univé has developed an AI-ready workforce by integrating ChatGPT Enterprise, focusing on leadership, responsible governance, and fostering employee-led innovation. This initiative aims to enhance work processes and drive transformation across the organization.

articles.title: Anthropic Says Claude Hacked 3 Organizations During Cybersecurity Tests
articles.summary: Anthropic reported that its AI model, Claude, successfully hacked into three organizations during cybersecurity tests conducted by third parties. This finding emerged from a review initiated in response to a recent incident involving OpenAI's Hugging Face.

articles.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2: powering robotics with video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration
articles.summary: Gemini Robotics has introduced the ER 2, a system designed to enhance robotic capabilities through advanced video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration. This innovation aims to improve how robots reason and work together to address real-world challenges.

articles.title: AI hedge fund Situational Awareness may have sold its public portfolio, but it still has its Anthropic shares
articles.summary: AI hedge fund Situational Awareness has sold its public portfolio due to significant losses from leveraged bets, but retains its shares in Anthropic. The fund, founded by a former OpenAI researcher, continues to explore other investment opportunities.

articles.title: Reddit reports a solid quarter but shows signs of AI’s impact
articles.summary: Reddit reported a solid financial quarter, indicating positive performance amidst market challenges. However, concerns are emerging regarding its relationship with Google and the implications of AI on its platform.

articles.title: Eco3S: Complex Socio-Economic System Simulation via Agent-Based Models
articles.summary: The paper introduces Eco3S, a socio-economic system simulation framework designed to enhance economic research and policy analysis through agent-based modeling (ABM). It addresses challenges in current LLM-based ABM research, including modeling agent-environment interactions, facilitating counterfactual reasoning, and automating simulation workflows.

articles.title: Sim2Win: A Team-Agnostic, Event-Based Pre-Match Outcome Prediction and Tactical Profiling System for Football
articles.summary: The paper introduces Sim2Win, a team-agnostic framework designed for pre-match outcome prediction and tactical profiling in football, addressing limitations of traditional expert analysis and scouting systems. Utilizing StatsBomb open event data from multiple competitions, the system reframes match outcome prediction as a tactical decision-support challenge.

articles.title: (EC)2: Event-Centric Explainability for Cybersecurity Through Multi-Agent LLM Investigations
articles.summary: The paper presents an event-centric, detector-agnostic approach to enhancing explainability in cybersecurity alerts, addressing the limitations of feature-level explanations in operational investigations. By focusing on contextual relationships and actionable insights, the proposed method aims to improve the effectiveness of anomaly detection systems in security operations centers.

articles.title: FAS-R1: A Unified Multi-Task MLLM for Reasoning Face Anti-Spoofing
articles.summary: The article introduces FAS-R1, a unified multi-task multi-label learning model designed for face anti-spoofing (FAS) that enhances decision-making by providing attack semantics and image-grounded evidence. This model addresses limitations of existing FAS systems by moving beyond label-centric approaches and improving the optimization of challenging spoofing attacks.

articles.title: LLMET: Enabling Cross-Layer Evaluation of Emerging M3D Memories for Energy-Efficient LLM Serving
articles.summary: The article introduces LLMET, a framework designed to evaluate emerging monolithic 3D (M3D) memory technologies for improving energy efficiency in serving Large Language Models (LLMs). It addresses the significant energy challenges posed by data movement between on-chip cache and off-chip High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) as LLM deployment scales.

articles.title: HiFloat4 Format for End-To-End Reinforcement Learning Post-Training of Large Language Models
articles.summary: The article introduces HiFloat4, the first end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL) post-training method for large language models that operates at 4-bit precision for both rollout and training policies. A systematic study identifies that the primary source of performance degradation in FP4 RL is due to rollout activation quantization, where outliers significantly affect the dynamic range, causing many activation values to underflow.
